2115.summary: The class explores the concept of atonement through 2 Corinthians 5:18-19, emphasizing God's initiative in reconciling the world through Jesus Christ. It highlights the importance of understanding and practicing reconciliation in ecclesial life.

2116.summary: The class discusses the concept of atonement, focusing on how God reconciles the world to himself through Jesus Christ. It emphasizes the righteousness and honor due to God in the process of redemption and the necessity of Christ's death for the forgiveness of sins.

2117.summary: The class explores the concept of atonement, focusing on how God reconciles the world to himself through Jesus Christ. It emphasizes the responsibility of believers to act as ambassadors of this reconciliation, sharing the message of salvation with others.
